title: Cast Iron Skillet Frittata
ingredients: 8 oz. mushrooms, diced or finely chopped
1 tsp each of any of the following spices - oregano, basil, thyme, smoked paprika, cumin etc.
instructions: In a mixing bowl, whisk the eggs together and keep aside.
Heat a cast iron skillet on medium heat, and saute, the frittata ingredients. If the meat is raw, cook that first and then add the vegetables.
Add the desired seasonings and mix well.
Spread the sauteed mixture evenly in the skillet and add the cheese.
Pour the whisked eggs over the mixture and tilt the skillet around to ensure even settling.
Cook the frittata on the stove for 1-2 minutes and then put it in the oven for 8-10 minutes until the eggs are set.
Cut a slit in the frittata - if the egg mixture runs, bake for another couple of minutes.
Otherwise, pull the skillet out of the oven and allow to cool for a few minutes.
